rationale: The plan correctly centres the answer on GSVA per-sample scores over the human Hallmark collection (version 2026.1 named) computed on a blind VST matrix with the Gaussian kernel, tests the score matrix with limma under ~condition with an explicit control reference and BH adjustment, and delivers a condition-annotated clustered heatmap with an explicit statement of sample_01's position, keeping that sample unless a reason beyond depth appears. QC, a minimal justified count filter, in-model median-of-ratios normalization, apeglm shrinkage, and a full reporting record are all stated. Deductions: the plan runs a gene-level DESeq2 Wald test and two fgsea passes plus a Reactome/GO follow-up that answer a different question than the per-sample score request, adding weight the reference does not require; the heatmap is not stated to be row-scaled; and the limma test on the score matrix names BH but not the 0.05 alpha at the point of testing.
